comparison.objective: Join two boards evenly over three dowels.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually align three dowels with three sockets and press both seam corners evenly to avoid wedging.
comparison.success_condition: Boards fully seated, flush, flat, stable, and released within submillimetre gap limits.
comparison.reason: Multi-point alignment and even insertion are different from hammer-driven tang fracture. Generic bimanual alignment does not establish overlap, and this task produces no loose fragments or retained-insert damage hazard.
